verdict.rationale: Zep says it builds a Context Graph from documents and can recall that content later through hybrid graph search. However, the documented ingestible data types are only JSON, text, and messages, so there is no evidence of direct file upload. Images are not supported, and PDFs or other file formats are not shown as memory inputs. missing for 10: native image ingestion, PDF/file upload or parsing, documented file-to-memory workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can store images, PDFs, or other files as memory inputs and recall information from them later

citations.quote: Zep builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON.
JSON, text, and message | Data types that you can ingest into a Context Graph.
Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search.
